name: house-design-system
description: House design system: DTCG token source of truth, built to CSS (screen) and Typst (print).

scripts.verify:classhift: npm run build:tokens && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs classhift brands/classhift/specimen.html && node scripts/shoot.mjs brands/classhift/specimen.html
scripts.verify:chunaimun: npm run build:tokens && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs chunaimun brands/chunaimun/specimen.html && node scripts/shoot.mjs brands/chunaimun/specimen.html
scripts.print:chunaimun: npm run check:tokens && typst compile --root brands/chunaimun brands/chunaimun/print/interior-proof.typ
